title: Prune unselected verified-binding record staging in the canonical compiler

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

scope: Reduce explicit selected-signature staging inside the existing compile_relation_blocks owner. Do not retain verified-binding source/target indices and binding-record tuples for signatures that cannot be compiled, while preserving the all-binding admission-key set, source-count receipt semantics, discover-all behavior, edge/hyperedge refusal precedence and evidence-dag provenance. Retain edge_records where it still protects the existing validate-before-evidence boundary. Do not add another compiler, binding index, cache, backend, registry or public API.

audit.binding_records_before: When verified bindings were enabled, every Fourfold binding was converted to a RelationSignature, source/target integer indices and a retained binding_records tuple before explicit selected-signature filtering discarded unselected records later during fact materialization.
audit.edge_records_finding: Explicit same-plane Forest edges were already pruned before edge_records append, while discover-all necessarily retains discovered records. The edge staging also preserves full endpoint, undirected and cross-plane admission/refusal validation before evidence-dag atom hashing and fact materialization, so deleting it would change the current validate-before-evidence execution boundary and is not justified by this packet.
audit.binding_admission_boundary: included_binding_keys must continue to cover every included verified binding, including signatures outside the explicit selected set, because selected cross-plane ForestEdge admission checks use exact endpoint/relation identity rather than the fact-record staging set.
audit.receipt_boundary: verified_binding_count is a source count when verified bindings are included, not a selected-record count. Earlier GPU-40/GPU-41 evidence and current selected-pruning contracts require len(snapshot.bindings) under include_verified_bindings=True and zero under False.
audit.safe_deletion: Decouple verified_binding_count into one scalar source count, populate included_binding_keys for every included binding, then skip source/target index lookup and binding_records tuple retention when an explicit requested set excludes that signature. Because both retained record families are then selection-correct, remove the later selected_set allocation and duplicate membership branches.

production.change: Compute the verified-binding source count independently; retain all exact included_binding_keys; in explicit-signature mode skip unselected binding index/tuple staging before binding_records append; remove the now-redundant selected_set allocation and record-loop membership checks; emit the independent source count in the receipt. edge_records staging remains unchanged where it is semantically useful.

coverage: An explicit selected relation does not materialize an unselected verified-binding fact.
verified_binding_count remains len(snapshot.bindings) under explicit selected-signature pruning.
An explicitly selected cross-plane relation still uses its exact included verified binding.
include_verified_bindings=False still refuses an observed selected cross-plane Forest relation before fact materialization.
Discover-all continues to materialize all observed relation families.
focused_existing_contract.reason_no_new_test_file: The existing focused owner already pins the affected public semantics; hosted integrated contracts verify the implementation without creating duplicate test plumbing.

semantic_invariants.discover_all: When signatures is None, every included verified binding is still staged/discovered and every retained representable relation is compiled as before.
semantic_invariants.binding_admission: included_binding_keys still covers every included verified binding before explicit relation filtering, preserving exact cross-plane ForestEdge admission and refusal semantics.
semantic_invariants.verified_binding_count: The receipt remains a source count: len(snapshot.bindings) when include_verified_bindings is True and zero when False, independent of explicit signature selection.
semantic_invariants.refusal_precedence: Hyperedge validation remains before binding/edge staging. edge_records remains staged so Forest endpoint, directionality and binding-admission checks complete before evidence-dag Forest atom/fact materialization.
semantic_invariants.evidence_dag: Selected verified-binding digest/evidence bundles and selected Forest evidence alternatives are unchanged; only tuples for unselected verified-binding signatures are no longer retained.
semantic_invariants.scalar_observers: Boolean remains True and natural remains unit 1 per deduplicated semantic coordinate.
semantic_invariants.source_of_truth: KnowledgeForest and FourfoldSnapshot remain authoritative; compiled tensor relation blocks remain regenerable computational views.
semantic_invariants.public_api: No public API, compatibility facade, wire schema, benchmark schema, promotion or authority contract changes.

result.summary: Explicit selected-signature compilation no longer retains index/tuple records for verified bindings that can never contribute a block. Exact binding admission still sees the full included binding set, receipt counting remains source-based, and the existing Forest edge staging is retained because it still enforces validate/refuse-before-evidence behavior.

bounded_next_step: GPU-88 only: audit included_binding_keys retention under explicit requested signatures. Determine whether exact admission keys for binding signatures outside the requested set can be skipped without weakening selected cross-plane ForestEdge admission/refusal, verified_binding_count source semantics, discover-all behavior, include_verified_bindings=False refusal or error precedence. Do not merge admission identity with fact storage and do not introduce another binding index/cache; if key pruning would make the admission proof less direct or create a second policy, retain the full key set and close the audit as research.
